summary: Vampyres are usually done as vyrewatch sentinels in Darkmeyer after Sins of the Father, using melee with a tier 3 vampyrebane weapon (Ivandis flail, blisterwood flail, hallowed flail or sunspear) and Protect from Melee, since sentinels only use melee and are aggressive without a vyre noble disguise. Efaritay's aid stacks with the slayer helmet and is recommended. The Darkmeyer area west of the Arboretum has an altar and bank next to the Drakan's medallion teleport, and sentinels drop the valuable blood shard; after The Blood Moon Rises, venators in Vampyrium are the harder but more lucrative alternative. Low-level tasks (Mazchna or Vannaka, before the Actual Vampyre Slayer unlock) are done on feral vampyres in the Haunted Woods.
styleNotes: Tier 1 feral vampyres take damage from anything; tier 2 juvinates need silver weapons or Efaritay's aid; tier 3 vyrewatch, sentinels and venators can only be damaged by tier 3 vampyrebane weapons or blisterwood stakes; vyrewatch, sentinels and venators are immune to poison, venom and cannon.
requiredItems: Tier 3 vampyrebane weapon (Ivandis flail, blisterwood flail, hallowed flail, sunspear or blisterwood stakes) for vyrewatch, sentinels and venators
Silver weaponry or Efaritay's aid for vampyre juvinates
usefulItems: Efaritay's aid
Vyre noble clothing (disguise to stop aggression)
Drakan's medallion
Garlic cocktail (re-enables sentinel aggression after The Blood Moon Rises)
Nature and fire runes for alching juvinate drops
alternatives: Venators (Vampyrium, after The Blood Moon Rises)

summary: Wall beasts are a low-level Mazchna task done in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves with melee. A light source is needed in the caves (a bullseye lantern is safest because open flames can ignite swamp gas), and an antipoison is worth carrying in case a cave slime or cave crawler is attacked. The south-west corner has two spawns close together; killing one respawns the others.

summary: Warped creatures live only in the Poison Waste Dungeon (partial The Path of Glouphrie, reached via the spirit tree) and are invulnerable unless a crystal chime is in the inventory. The whole dungeon is multi-combat and cannonable; the second large chamber with a cannon on the north-western tortoise spawn is the recommended spot for killing both.
styleNotes: Tortoises are weak to crush and heavy ranged (20% earth weakness); terrorbirds have no elemental weakness and switch between melee and ranged based on your prayer; both are cannonable; a crystal chime is required to damage either.

summary: Waterfiends are a rare Konar or Duradel task fought with crush melee (or earth spells, which they are 100% weak to) while wearing magic-defence armour such as dragonhide, since both their magic and magical ranged attacks roll against magic defence and no single prayer blocks everything. Protect from Missiles helps most if damage is high. The Ancient Cavern (games necklace to Barbarian Assault, then the whirlpool) is the usual spot and lets you safespot across the river with Ranged or Magic because their attack range is only 4 tiles; Iorwerth Dungeon has 20 spawns and allows a cannon but needs Song of the Elves. Many players skip the task because the drops are poor.
styleNotes: Low crush defence (use crush weapons or heavy ranged); 100% weakness to earth spells; immune to poison and venom; attacks with magic and magical ranged; not immune to cannon.
usefulItems: Crush weapon (inquisitor's mace, abyssal bludgeon, soulreaper axe on crush)

summary: Werewolves are a Vannaka-only task done in Canifis, where they walk around as level 24 humans and transform into level 88 werewolves when attacked; kills only count once they have transformed, so do not finish them with Wolfbane equipped. Melee with Protect from Melee is standard, and they can be safespotted over the STASH unit in the village centre or from behind the bar and tables in the pub. A popular method is to set up a cannon in the middle of Canifis and run the rooftop course, or hide inside a building with the door closed so the cannon hits the stacked werewolves. Stronger, aggressive versions exist in the God Wars Dungeon and its Wilderness counterpart.
styleNotes: Slash attackers with no poison or venom resistance; not immune to cannon; Wolfbane keeps them in human form, which does not count for the task.
usefulItems: Dwarf multicannon
Wolfbane (optional, to lower incoming damage while in human form)

summary: Wyrms (62 Slayer) can be completed on adult wyrms, wyrmlings or lava strykewyrms. Adult wyrms use melee up close and magic from range, so Ranged with Protect from Magic from outside melee distance, or melee with a dragonbane weapon such as the dragon hunter lance, are standard; wyrmlings are melee-only with half the health; lava strykewyrms are aggressive, use melee and ranged and are immune to cannon. The wiki recommends Wyrmscraig (62 Sailing, partial Fallen From Grace) because the surface wyrmling nest is multi-combat, cannonable and beside a bank and the necklace of passage teleport, and the Wyrmscraig Cavern below holds adult wyrms and strykewyrms with a slayer ring teleport. In the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon you need boots of stone, brimstone or granite boots unless the elite Kourend and Kebos diary is done, and cannons cannot be placed in the wyrm area.
styleNotes: Draconic, so dragonbane weapons (dragon hunter lance, crossbow, wand) are strong; adult wyrms have 1 flat armour, are immune to poison and venom and are 50% weak to earth spells; lava strykewyrms are 50% weak to water spells and immune to cannon but not to poison; the Shadow Wyrm superior cannot be safespotted.
usefulItems: Boots of stone, boots of brimstone or granite boots (Karuulm, unless elite Kourend and Kebos diary)
Dragon hunter lance / dragon hunter crossbow
